summary: Frontend testing for NewVehicle smart plate search with Arabic/English digit normalization. Found 1 bug: single-character plate search doesn't show results due to showCustomerResults condition. All other features working correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Single-character plate search ('0', 'ا') doesn't show results dropdown
ui_bugs.root_cause: Line 152-154: showCustomerResults requires customerSearch.length >= 2, but allowSingleCharacterPlateSearch (line 125) is for q.length === 1. These conditions conflict.

single_char_plate_search_0.details: Search '0' returns no dropdown due to showCustomerResults condition requiring length >= 2

full_plate_search_0000.details: Search '0000' returns 4 results with plate displayed (🚘 0000)

arabic_digits_search.details: Search '٠٠٠' (Arabic zeros) returns 6 results - normalizeArabicDigits working correctly

customer_selection.details: Clicking result populates customer fields and shows 'عميل مسجل' badge

results_display_plate.details: Results show plate icon (🚘) when customer has plate data

debounce_and_cache.details: 220ms debounce working, local cache + remote archiveSearch fallback active

code_review.normalizeArabicDigits: Line 74 - Correctly converts Arabic/Persian digits (٠-٩, ۰-۹) to English (0-9)
code_review.normalizePlateCanonical: Lines 76-91 - Transliterates Arabic letters to English equivalents for matching
code_review.allowSingleCharacterPlateSearch: Line 125 - Logic exists but blocked by showCustomerResults condition
code_review.showCustomerResults_bug: Lines 152-154 - Requires length >= 2, blocking single-char plate searches

action_items: Fix showCustomerResults condition (line 152-154) to allow single-character plate searches when results exist
critical_code_review_comments: BUG: allowSingleCharacterPlateSearch (line 125) is implemented but blocked by showCustomerResults condition (line 152-154) which requires customerSearch.length >= 2
context_for_next_testing_agent: NewVehicle smart plate search tested. Arabic digit normalization (٠٠٠→000) working. Single-char plate search has bug - showCustomerResults blocks it. Fix needed in line 152-154.
